1. Click 'Open login page' above (a new browser tab opens).
2. In the new tab, press F12 and switch to the 'Network' tab.
3. Enable persistent logging:
   • Chrome / Edge / Brave: Check 'Preserve log'.
   • Firefox: Click gear ⚙️ ➔ check 'Persist Logs'.
1. Enter your Miele app account email an:
1. Enter your Miele app account email and password and click 'Sign in'.
2. Note: After login, the page will hang on a spinning loading wheel (or show an error). This is completely normal and indicates success!
1. In the Network tab (F12), scroll to t:
1. In the Network tab (F12), scroll to the very last (often red) request starting with 'redirect?redirect_uri=miele...' or 'miele://oauth2-code/...'.
2. Right-click that entry ➔ 'Copy URL' / 'Copy link address'.
3. Paste the URL into the field below and click 'Fetch GroupKey'.
Also write to the history adapter: Also write to the history adapter
Appliances report changes immediately in: Appliances report changes immediately instead of being polled. Not every module can do this: older XKM accept the subscription but send nothing.
Creates the appliance's internal values: Creates the appliance's internal values as states – heating relay, water level, drum speed and more. The field names come from public projects and are unverified.
Creates the state names bilingually; the: Creates the state names bilingually; the admin then shows them in German. Takes effect after saving and restarting.
Creates writable states. Commands only t: Creates writable states. Commands only take effect while MobileStart is enabled on the appliance; some firmwares reject them outright.
Energy, water and duration per cycle, ti: Energy, water and duration per cycle, timestamped at the end of the cycle – so charts can cover any period.
Finds appliances via mDNS on the same ne: Finds appliances via mDNS on the same network. Multicast does not pass through a Docker bridge network – then enter the IP addresses below by hand.
For appliances the scan does not find, a: For appliances the scan does not find, and whenever multicast does not get through. One row per appliance.
How many recent cycles are kept in cycle: How many recent cycles are kept in cyclesJson. Meant for quick display; long-term data comes from the history adapter.
How often the adapter polls while a prog: How often the adapter polls while a programme is running.
How often the adapter polls while no pro: How often the adapter polls while no programme is running.
If a manually entered device stops answe: If a manually entered device stops answering, the adapter probes its own /24 network once (at most every 30 minutes). Needed when the appliances get their IP via DHCP and mDNS does not get through - for instance inside a Docker bridge network.
Instance of the cloud adapter the refere: Instance of the cloud adapter the reference values come from, for example mielecloudservice.0.
Must be reachable inbound from the appli: Must be reachable inbound from the appliance network. In a Docker container this reliably works only with network_mode: host.
Normally set through the login. Enter by: Normally set through the login. Enter by hand only if GroupID and GroupKey are already known.
Number of the field in the eco leaf that: Number of the field in the eco leaf that carries the energy. The default fits the WCR860; on other models determine it via the data collection.
Number of the field in the eco leaf that carries the water volume. The default fits the WCR860; on other models determine it via the data collection.
Older entries drop out of the ring buffe: Older entries drop out of the ring buffer. 730 days is two years.
Once retrieved, GroupID and encrypted Gr: Once retrieved, GroupID and encrypted GroupKey appear on the 'Advanced' tab. Don't forget to save.
Only for devices whose search has never: Only for devices whose search has never run. A device that is off most of the time would otherwise never be searched. The search only reads, and stops as soon as the device is off again.
Reads energy and water via DOP2. Only ap: Reads energy and water via DOP2. Only appliances that provide it – so far washing machines.
Reads remaining and elapsed time to the: Reads remaining and elapsed time to the second via DOP2 instead of only in minutes.
Records every completed programme. The a: Records every completed programme. The appliances keep nothing – the history starts when you switch this on and cannot be filled retroactively.
Records one dataset per programme with m: Records one dataset per programme with model, programme and all raw fields. From cloud values or your own entries the adapter derives the field mapping.
Requires a running instance of the miele: Requires a running instance of the mielecloudservice adapter.
Search the subnet for the new IP if a de: Search the subnet for the new IP if a device drops out
Start the leaf search when a device is s: Start the leaf search when a device is switched on
Step 1: Click \"Open login page\" and si: Step 1: Click "Open login page" and sign in with your Miele account in the browser. At the end the browser tries to open an address of the form "miele://oauth2-code/?code=…&state=…". This complete address (the "code") is needed in step 2.
Step 3: Copy redirect address & fetch Gr: Step 3: Copy redirect address & fetch GroupKey
Stored encrypted and never shown in clea: Stored encrypted and never shown in clear text.
The adapter retrieves local credentials: The adapter retrieves local credentials (GroupID/GroupKey) once by signing in with your Miele account. The Miele app continues to work as before. No credentials are transmitted to third parties.
The consumption reported by the applianc: The consumption reported by the appliance is an estimate, not a measurement. If you have a metering plug in front of it, enter its meter state here.
These settings serve troubleshooting and: These settings serve troubleshooting and field mapping. They are not needed for daily operation and are off by default. Collected data stays in this instance.
Without cloud: after each programme, ent: Without cloud: after each programme, enter energy and water from the Miele app into "collection.inputEnergy" and "collection.inputWater" - they are attached to the most recent dataset. "collection.progress" shows what is still missing.
Writes all fields of the eco leaf to eco: Writes all fields of the eco leaf to eco.fieldsJson instead of only the two evaluated ones. Helps when energy or water arrive wrong on your model.
Writes two tables and opens the first: o: Writes two tables and opens the first: one row per programme with all raw fields, plus an analysis with one row per field. Take care when sharing – the table contains the programme timestamps.
